result.notes: Measured on real emulator runtime. workflow_success_rate=0 is due to the benchmark's success criteria: it fetches published listings using a text `searchQuery` equal to the new `listing.id`, but the search filter matches title/location/description rather than listing ids—so the 'found' check fails. message_latency_ms=0 indicates the send->stream latency measurement did not produce a recorded latency value in this run.

PERF_PROBE_RESULT.notes: response_time_* aggregates measured Firestore operations. workflow_success_rate is benchmark workflow pass percentage. message_latency_ms measures send->stream-observed latency.
